c22-knowledge-pass.note: NEW, PRE-C14, from RAI'S REAL-DEVICE TESTING of v0.3.37 on latios (2026-08-28). POSSIBLE LIVE BUG — CONTEXT MAP GENERATES NO KNOWLEDGE. No knowledge/ dir. Forty minutes of subscription spend, zero output — and it retries TWICE WITH THE IDENTICAL PROMPT, so it fails identically twice. Deterministic on any real repo; a 3-file scratch repo SUCCEEDS (8 statements, correct provenance), so the pipeline is sound, #544/#546 do cover it, and this is PURELY A SIZE CEILING. REAL-RUN PROOF REQUIRED (a unit test on chunking would be the vacuous-green pattern in exactly the place it already bit us). e569-e2e-harness.note: LANDED #579 @403e84fc. ISSUE #569. RAI RULED DIRECTLY (2026-08-28): upgrade Playwright AND Electron to the latest MUTUALLY-COMPATIBLE versions — NOT a minimal pin-back, NOT a workaround, and NOT amending C14's packet around it. LATEST COMPATIBLE, NOT LATEST INDEPENDENTLY — picking each side's newest in isolation is exactly how 43.2.0 met 1.62.0. If they cannot both be latest, take the newest compatible PAIR and report the constraint; never silently pick one side. Dependency standard + npmrc min-release-age=7 planned around, NOT overridden. ACCEPTANCE BAR: the four pre-existing desktop E2E specs actually RUN AND PASS (not merely that electron.launch stops erroring), plus rennet-desktop:package-smoke, plus full pnpm check with a GATE_EXIT line. c20's corner-slot spec runs as an informational fifth — its verdict is c20's business. ONE agent on these files. | *** FIXED @de61a1ce (GATE_EXIT=0, package-smoke PASS) — AND THE DIAGNOSIS OVERTURNED OUR WHOLE THEORY. IT WAS NEVER A VERSION MISMATCH. ROOT CAUSE: ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1 is exported into every shell whose parent is itself an Electron app — INCLUDING THE AGENT TERMINAL THIS BUILD RUNS IN. Both apps/desktop/e2e/harness.ts and scripts/smoke-packaged-app.mjs spread process.env into the launch, so the Electron binary ran as BARE NODE and Playwright's --remote-debugging-port hit NODE'S option parser.
